title: OT device classification groups
description: Stable English product groups. IDs and keys are permanent. Select the primary documented product purpose, not an installed role, Purdue level, physical identity, or certification. Safety takes precedence only for dedicated safety products, not ordinary products with an optional safety feature. Electrical protection is separate from functional safety. Unknown products use Other.

const.name: PLC
const.description: Programmable logic controllers and dedicated industrial logic controllers.

const.name: Functional safety
const.description: Dedicated safety controllers, safety I/O, safety relays, interlocks, and protective light curtains. Does not establish a safety certification.

const.name: Robotics
const.description: Industrial, collaborative, and mobile robots, robot controllers, and robotic cells.

const.name: HMI
const.description: Operator panels, graphical terminals, and industrial displays.

const.name: RTU
const.description: Remote terminal units and flow computers.

const.name: Process and machine control
const.description: DCS, CNC, process, welding, and other specialized machine control systems, excluding dedicated PLCs and safety systems.

const.name: Network device
const.description: Switches, routers, gateways, radios, taps, and communication adapters or modules.

const.name: Industrial computer
const.description: Industrial PCs, edge computers, thin clients, emulators, and prototyping computers. Does not imply an engineering or SCADA deployment.

const.name: I/O module
const.description: Remote, digital, analog, and special-purpose I/O and IO-Link masters, excluding dedicated safety I/O.

const.name: Drives and motion control
const.description: Drives, frequency converters, motor starters, servo modules, and motion controllers.

const.name: Sensor / actuator
const.description: Sensors, transmitters, valves, motors, and actuators, excluding dedicated safety devices.

const.name: Measurement and monitoring
const.description: Meters, recorders, condition monitoring, machine vision, and environmental measurement equipment.

const.name: Power supply and storage
const.description: Power supplies, UPS devices, batteries, buffer and redundancy modules, converters, and chargers.

const.name: Electrical protection
const.description: Circuit breakers, protection relays, fuses, surge protection, and EMC filters. Not functional-safety classification.

const.name: Power distribution
const.description: Switchgear, busbars, distribution units, and electrical distribution systems.

const.name: Electrical switching
const.description: Contactors, general-purpose relays, transfer switches, and disconnectors.

const.name: Signal conditioning
const.description: Signal isolators, converters, amplifiers, and conditioning networks.

const.name: Mechanical equipment
const.description: Pumps, compressors, conveyors, presses, test rigs, and other mechanical production equipment.

const.name: Cooling equipment
const.description: Industrial cooling and enclosure thermal management.

const.name: Building automation
const.description: Building and room automation controllers and thermostats.

const.name: Physical security
const.description: Access control, credentials, surveillance cameras, and intercoms.

const.name: Fire detection and alarm
const.description: Fire detectors, alarm panels, evacuation notification, and voice alarm systems.

const.name: Infrastructure and accessories
const.description: Chassis, racks, backplanes, connectors, cables, carriers, and other passive accessories.

const.name: Other
const.description: Insufficient evidence for a more specific classification. Do not infer a group from the manufacturer alone.
